    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = 7
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg, 2)]

code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (5, 7, 2)]
    if not cells:
        return out
    line = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 2]
    if len({r for r, c in line}) == 1:
        # Move the object upward/downward until its bounding box is next to the 2-line.
        lr = line[0][0]
        top, bottom = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
        dr = (lr + 1 - top) if lr < top else (lr - 1 - bottom)
        moved = [(r + dr, c) for r, c in cells]
        marker = (max(r for r, c in moved) + 1) if dr < 0 else (min(r for r, c in moved) - 1)
        for r, c in cells:
            out[r][c] = 7
        for (r, c), (nr, nc) in zip(cells, moved):
            out[nr][nc] = grid[r][c]
        if 0 <= marker < h:
            out[marker] = [8] * w
    elif len({c for r, c in line}) == 1:
        lc = line[0][1]
        left, right = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
        dc = (lc + 1 - left) if lc < left else (lc - 1 - right)
        moved = [(r, c + dc) for r, c in cells]
        marker = (max(c for r, c in moved) + 1) if dc < 0 else (min(c for r, c in moved) - 1)
        for r, c in cells:
            out[r][c] = 5 if any(5 in row for row in grid) else 7
        for (r, c), (nr, nc) in zip(cells, moved):
            out[nr][nc] = grid[r][c]
        if 0 <= marker < w:
            for r in range(h):
                out[r][marker] = 8
    return out
'''
